primary_question: Does CI's retained aggregate hide first-input or first-retained-key wait sensitivity?
primary_metric: per-key-position latency distributions plus retained aggregate q50
inclusion_rule: all generated keys, separately flagged as throwaway, first retained, later retained, failure, retry, or missing
required_controls: same startup waits, same post setup, same key mode, same retained-key rule
stop_rule: split retained typing from idle-input metric if key-position tails remain
forbidden_interpretation: calling flat retained q50 proof that first input after idle is stable

primary_question: Can startup waits be reduced without moving readiness work into measurement?
primary_metric: reported q50 plus failures, retries, resources, first-key tails, retained counts, and run order
inclusion_rule: all target-lane runs, including failed/actionability rows and late resources
required_controls: current wait, zero/short waits, longer wait, resource and failure capture
stop_rule: wait reduction passes only if all non-q50 readiness fields pass
forbidden_interpretation: using improved q50 while ignoring failures, retries, resources, or first-key tails

primary_question: Can a source predicate replace the fixed pattern wait without moving preview/canvas/resource work?
primary_metric: pattern readiness time, resource quiet, preview/canvas state, failures, retained q50
inclusion_rule: all site/post pattern-loading rows with predicate fires, resources, and preview/canvas checks retained
stop_rule: keep fixed fallback unless predicate and resource quiet preserve behavior
forbidden_interpretation: using predicate q50 without proving it marks the same readiness boundary

artifact: Selector behavior fixtures plus source spans
primary_question: Does a selector guard preserve behavior and collapse the targeted source span?
primary_metric: behavior fixture pass/fail, targeted source-span count/time, then aggregate p50
inclusion_rule: all behavior fixtures before timing rows; all source-span rows for the targeted owner
required_controls: baseline source spans, guarded source spans, aggregate p50 only after behavior passes
stop_rule: do not cite timing if behavior fails or source span does not collapse
forbidden_interpretation: calling aggregate p50 a safe source optimization

primary_question: Can fanout reduction preserve public data semantics?
primary_metric: public subscribe order, persistence selector behavior, dynamic/cross-store dependency behavior, marker-only fanout
inclusion_rule: all compatibility fixtures, including plugin/public subscriber smoke and async/race cases
required_controls: current public root subscribe, private/internal filtered lane, marker-only fanout control
stop_rule: veto public-path fanout on any compatibility failure
forbidden_interpretation: treating listener-count reduction as API compatibility

primary_question: Is the held-key cliff specific to key-hold input shape?
primary_metric: delay sweep q50 by key mode with persistence markers and retained-key rules fixed
inclusion_rule: matched startup state, retained-key filtering, key mode, and browser revision
required_controls: tap-then-wait, fixed short hold, Playwright held-key path
stop_rule: narrow input-shape wording if tap or short hold reproduces the cliff
forbidden_interpretation: calling a held-key-only result general typing behavior

primary_question: Do browser lanes preserve the controlled dip under the same input and persistence markers?
primary_metric: per-browser delay curve, key mode, persistence markers, and retained-key ordering
inclusion_rule: all browser rows under same key-mode and inclusion rules
required_controls: same delay grid and key-mode controls in each browser
stop_rule: split browser wording if any browser loses the controlled dip
forbidden_interpretation: naming a one-browser mechanism from cross-browser aggregate similarity

primary_question: Can sidecar observation join retained keys without perturbing ordering?
primary_metric: join coverage, clock-sync error, renderer/helper identity, observer-on/off ordering
inclusion_rule: all retained keys and all observer-off/on paired rows
required_controls: observer-off baseline, passive sidecar, repeated checkpoint controls
stop_rule: do not proceed to root counters or trace if joins or ordering fail
forbidden_interpretation: naming mechanisms from a sidecar that changed class ordering

primary_question: Which runtime checkpoint state, if any, separates fast and slow retained-key classes?
primary_metric: joined runtime checkpoint fields by retained-key class with observer overhead check
inclusion_rule: only rows from an accepted passive sidecar schema
stop_rule: keep empirical wording unless runtime fields separate classes without perturbation
forbidden_interpretation: renaming aggregate latency classes as V8 or scheduler state

primary_question: Do CPU/QoS counters separate fast and slow retained-key classes?
primary_metric: joined frequency, residency, QoS, power, and runnable-latency counters by retained key
inclusion_rule: only rows from accepted passive sidecar plus complete root-counter windows
required_controls: sidecar accepted baseline, powermetrics, root trace only if counters fail
stop_rule: do not name CPU/QoS mechanism unless joined counters separate classes
forbidden_interpretation: calling latency classes frequency, QoS, cache, or scheduler causes

primary_question: Do non-fixed-x workloads reproduce the same owners, effects, and failures?
primary_metric: per-stratum behavior assertions, source spans, endpoints, and q50/p90 summaries
inclusion_rule: all replay strata, including failures and missing assertions
required_controls: fixed-x baseline, synthetic replay, recorded/specialized strata
stop_rule: generalize only to strata that reproduce the effect
forbidden_interpretation: averaging missing or failing strata into a product-latency claim

primary_question: Does user-visible or physical display timing preserve the internal endpoint ordering?
primary_metric: calibrated OCR/present/camera endpoint joined to retained-key windows
inclusion_rule: all endpoint rows with calibration, dropped-frame, and join-status flags
required_controls: Chromium screenshot/paint/DrawFrame, external endpoint, calibration control
stop_rule: keep Chromium-internal wording unless external endpoint preserves ordering

primary_question: Does repository q50 movement map to pass/fail or reviewer action?
primary_metric: archived raw CI artifact movement joined to dashboard/reviewer policy outcomes
inclusion_rule: all available artifacts, including noisy-metric and non-actioned rows
required_controls: raw artifact, displayed q50, dashboard/reviewer threshold or decision
stop_rule: do not predict pass/fail until policy matches raw artifact movement
forbidden_interpretation: treating printed q50 as the pass/fail rule
